_readme: INTERNAL REVIEW NOTES for the evidence ledger. Not deployed: docs/ is stripped from the Pages build.
The public, publishable ledger is data/seo/evidence-ledger.json. Entries here are claims that are not yet verified,
owner statements without a document, or owner actions on published evidence. Move an entry to the public ledger
only when its evidence has been opened and says what the entry says.

entries.event: Résumé claims checked against the IPC engagement document
entries.summary: The IPC engagement document's cover page is titled 'Infrastructure Associate'; both résumé pages give the IPC role as 'Infrastructure Engineer'. The document also lists 'Provide instruction to new team members' under the heading 'Leadership (Kevin)', while the résumé claims 'instructed new team members'. The IT résumé additionally lists Active Directory, Microsoft 365, imaging and ticketing at IPC, which the document does not mention.
entries.owner_action: Confirm the job title of record with PeopleSERVE/IPC and align both résumé pages (an employment check reports the title of record), and confirm or remove the instruction and IPC-specific Microsoft 365/Active Directory bullets. The new engineering pages avoid all three claims until this is settled.

entries.summary: The album's structured data says datePublished 2026 with no day. The ISRCs (QT6KV26000xx) were assigned in 2026.
entries.owner_action: Supply the release date (and the distributor's release record, if any) so the album and its tracks can carry an exact datePublished and a dated newsroom entry.

entries.event: Connecticut General Assembly citation to Apex Kingdom
entries.summary: A third citation of the same date names Apex Kingdom, a separate entity listed in data/dossier.json.
entries.owner_action: Apex Kingdom is a separate entity and a religious affiliation; it is not presented in the newsroom or the entity graph unless the owner asks for it.

entries.event: Whip Equipped LLC organized in Georgia
entries.summary: The résumé says Whip Equipped LLC was organized in Acworth, Georgia in 2024 and operated as a parts-licensed dealership through September 2026.
entries.supporting_evidence: Résumé only; no formation document in the repository.
entries.owner_action: Add the Georgia Secretary of State record (or its public URL) to verify the formation date. Also confirm the Georgia base used on public pages: the profile says Acworth, the booking page says Decatur.

entries.event: Enrolled at Southern Connecticut State University, computer science major
entries.summary: Matthew McCluster is a current first-year undergraduate (freshman) at Southern Connecticut State University, majoring in computer science, still earning credits.
factual_claims: Not a graduate: no degree is claimed
entries.supporting_evidence: Owner statement in the working session, 2026-10-03. No enrollment document in the repository.
entries.owner_action: Optional: an enrollment verification letter or the SCSU student-directory listing would let this be marked verified. data/dossier.json records expected graduation May 2030 (from #311).

entries.summary: catalogue.html now carries MusicRecording markup for 14 recordings. Matthew McCluster is credited as artist only where nothing on the site credits anybody else. 'Money or the Power' is credited to Old Jay (per docket-516.html: Old Jay ft. Ocho, prod. Pax) although data/catalogue.json has no credit for it. 'Dealer Plates' carries Matthew as co-producer only; 'Upset' carries no artist claim. CIA Mind Control is listed as an album with no artist and no track list, and its gated title is never written into the page or the markup.
entries.owner_action: Add the 'Money or the Power' credit to data/catalogue.json; decide the public artist credit for CIA Mind Control; confirm who performs 'Upset' and 'Dealer Plates'. Then update CREDIT in tools/build-catalogue.mjs and rebuild.
